thought.text:
Tidak ada alias berprefix. Jadi memang buntu di sisi nomask.

Sekarang saya tes jalan lain: **obscurify** (yang sudah jalan di OpenHands) — apakah dia bisa jadi perantara ke nomask? Dan cek cara OpenHands memperlakukan model.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && grep -oE "nmk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]+" ob_accounts.txt 2>/dev/null | head -2; echo "=== format ob_accounts ==="; head -2 ob_accounts.txt 2>/dev/null; echo "=== cek model obscurify apakah ada deepseek uncensored ==="; OB=$(grep -oE "sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+|ob_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+" ob_accounts.txt 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "key: ${OB:0:20}..."

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/project && grep -oE \"nmk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]+\" ob_accounts.txt 2>/dev/null | head -2; echo \"=== format ob_accounts ===\"; head -2 ob_accounts.txt 2>/dev/null; echo \"=== cek model obscurify apakah ada deepseek uncensored ===\"; OB=$(grep -oE \"sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+|ob_[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\" ob_accounts.txt 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo \"key: ${OB:0:20}...\"", "summary": "Check obscurify accounts format", "security_risk": "LOW", "timeout": 90}
